reason: palette.light is a background role (a near-white surface, used for light-mode fills and hover backgrounds), not a text role. Applying it as an @ds-surface(outlined light)/@ds-button(outlined light)/@ds-input(outlined light) tone asks for text painted in that same near-white color on the page's own near-white background — the combination is unsupported by the nature of the role, not a color this theme's own palette can fix without giving `light` a second, contradictory meaning as a text color. Story reproduction (MIG-B6-29 'Por qué'): documented as the canonical example of this exact class of exception, ratio 1.10:1.
